To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the status quo affects choice through three channels: (a) the status quo is privileged and hence is considered with certainty, (b) the status quo directs attention to a subset of alternatives, and (c) the status quo focuses attention on a particular subset of alternatives.
